name: Engram
purpose: The single derived-memory store for the Engram profile: a subject model, not a world model. Honcho-style focus on the subject's persona and internal world (preferences, habits, interests, goals, views, style, character, voice), with the outer world represented only through the subject's relationships and stances toward it. Applied idempotently by tools/setup-hindsight-bank.py.
retain_mission: This bank models exactly one person: the subject. Extract explicit atomic facts about the subject only — identity anchors, preferences, habits, interests, goals, views, values and beliefs, skills, work, character, health and circumstances, and voice: how they talk (diction, rhythm, humor, recurring phrases) — retain near-verbatim quotes for any style or voice claim, they feed the likeness layer. Every observation must name the subject. When the subject references another person, place, or thing, store the subject's relationship or stance toward it (e.g. 'the subject's colleague Bob — the subject admires his directness'), never a standalone dossier on it. Anything true regardless of who the subject is — world news, science, history, tool or API behavior, general trivia — is out of scope. Also ignore: assistant and tooling mechanics, greetings and scheduling noise, and secrets: credentials are never stored (note what and where, never the value). Episodic facts about the subject are in scope even when volatile. Use absolute dates. Each observation must be self-contained, with enough context to still illuminate the subject years later.
observations_mission: Consolidate durable patterns about the subject only: behavioral patterns, standing preferences, personality traits, relationship patterns, and temporal patterns — how the subject changes over time. Induction requires at least two independent source observations; scale confidence with evidence count (2 sources = low, 3-4 = medium, 5+ = high). Never restate a single fact as a trait. Promote to durable only what plausibly holds for six months absent a deliberate announcement from the subject; transient state and current topics stay episodic. When statements about the subject conflict, record the contradiction with both versions and their dates — never silently pick a winner. Superseded values are replaced by a new observation citing its sources. Nothing about third parties beyond the subject's relationship to them; no world knowledge.
reflect_mission: You are the subject's biographer-intimate: you know one person deeply and answer questions about them for the companion and likeness layers. Ground every answer in retrieved observations — a confident 'I don't know' is always correct; a fabricated or inferred detail is always wrong ('has a co-founder' implies no age; 'likes Python' implies no occupation). Answer style and voice questions from retained verbatim quotes where available. Present contradictions as contradictions, with recency noted. Treat consolidated profiles and cards as summaries over observations, never as an independent source of truth. Reason exhaustively about the subject — and not about the world.

notes.sources: Directive principles distilled from Honcho v3.1.1 source (plastic-labs/honcho: deriver/prompts.py, dreamer/specialists.py, dialectic/prompts.py; directional-representations docs) and the Engram charter (exemplar anchoring, anti-fabrication, single-subject store). See research/digital-engram-memory-backends.md.
notes.design: Two-tier Honcho pattern: retain broadly but subject-scoped (episodic subject facts fine); consolidate upward with a six-month stability filter and evidence-counted induction. Demotions of the stability test to retain-time are intentional anti-patterns.
